uutiset.t: Sterling given suspended sentence for dangerous driving
uutiset.s: Raheem Sterling was sentenced to 12 months imprisonment, suspended for 18 months, on Wednesday.

uutiset.t: Dottin out to 'free ball' after historic WBBL decision
uutiset.s: Brisbane's Sarah Glenn bowls to an empty set of stumps to dismiss Melbourne Renegade's Deandra Dottin after she is deemed too slow to reach the crease and face her first delivery.

uutiset.t: Mills an inspiration for Olympics hope Nieuwland
uutiset.s: Aspiring Welsh sailor Merle Nieuwland hopes to follow in double Olympic champion Hannah Mills' wake after world success at junior level.

uutiset.t: Murrell flourishing at high-flying Falkirk after 'random' move
uutiset.s: Jacob Murrell took a big step out of his comfort zone leaving the United States for Falkirk and is enjoying a blistering run of form in Scotland, if not the food.

uutiset.t: Brindle stands down as Wales women's coach
uutiset.s: Tom Brindle steps down as Wales women's rugby league coach after five years in charge.

uutiset.t: Ice hockey federation appeals against Russia ban ruling
uutiset.s: The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) will appeal to the Swiss Federal Tribunal against a Court of Arbitration for Sport (Cas) ruling to reinstate Russia in next year's World Championship.

uutiset.t: Lincoln sack head coach duo Cohen and Shaw
uutiset.s: Lincoln sack head coaches Chris Cohen and Tom Shaw just six months after they took joint charge of the Championship side.

uutiset.t: McCague 'understands' St Eunan's anger amid score controversy
uutiset.s: Scotstown manager David McCague says he "understands" why St Eunan's have lodged a formal objection after the decision to award his side's late extra-time equaliser in their Ulster Club SFC semi-final win at Brewster Park on Saturday.

uutiset.t: Watford appoint Iordanescu as head coach
uutiset.s: Watford appoint former Romania boss Edward Iordanescu as their new head coach after sacking Alessio Dionisi.

uutiset.t: Wales and West Ham's Morgan suffers serious injury
uutiset.s: Ffion Morgan looks set to miss the rest of the season for club and country following knee surgery.

uutiset.t: EA adds AI-generated John Motson to FC 27 video game
uutiset.s: The AI-generated Motson will appear in the game on 26 November, with the consent of his son and wife.

uutiset.t: Northants begin T20 Blast defence at Hampshire
uutiset.s: Northamptonshire Steelbacks will begin their T20 Blast defence at Hampshire, in a repeat of last season's final.
Former Australia batter Usman Khawaja says it was "never about me versus Pat" as the 2018 sandpapergate scandal rumbles on.
French tennis player Arthur Rinderknech says he expects to be exonerated over allegations he refused a doping test.

uutiset.t: Citing hearing was 'extra stress' for Prendergast
uutiset.s: Ireland's Sam Prendergast says head coach Andy Farrell was "unbelievably supportive" while the fly-half waited to find out whether he would be available to face South Africa last weekend.
